data.name: ToMarkdownNotice
data.value: Headings, lists, emphasis, links, tables, code and pictures are kept. Layout, colors, comments, tracked changes and scripts are left out.

data.name: ToMarkdownImagesNotice
data.value: Pictures are saved in a new folder named after the Markdown file, next to it; existing files are never overwritten.

data.name: ToMarkdownPdfNotice
data.value: PDFs are read from their text layer: tagged PDFs keep their headings, tables and lists; otherwise headings come from bookmarks or font sizes. A table of contents becomes a linked list, links stay links, footnotes become footnotes, tables are recognized by their columns even without borders, repeated headers, page numbers and logos are removed, and pictures are placed where they appear. Scanned PDFs need text recognition first.
